stories.title: Papa Leone XIV all'Eliseo per l'incontro con Macron. Ai giornalisti Cnn: "Felice che siate qui"

en.title: Pope Leo XIV at the Élysée for meeting with Macron. To CNN journalists: "Happy you are here"
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV visits UNESCO headquarters and delivers remarks on artificial intelligence, followed by visits to Notre Dame and a vigil at the Stade de France during his trip to France with the motto "That the world may have life".

stories.title: Omicidio a Torino, cadavere a pezzi nei sacchi. Donna al 112: "Mio figlio ha fatto del male"

en.title: Murder in Turin, dismembered body in bags. Woman to emergency services: "My son did something wrong"
en.summary: A woman calls emergency services reporting that her son committed a crime involving a dismembered body discovered in bags at an apartment in Turin's Madonna di Campagna neighborhood.

stories.title: Omicidio a Torino, il cadavere a pezzi nascosto in sacchi

en.title: Murder in Turin, dismembered body hidden in bags
en.summary: A Turin murder investigation involves a dismembered corpse concealed in bags, with knives found in a bucket alongside human remains.

stories.title: Giornalisti e Casa Bianca, Leone 'io contento che siete tutti qui'

en.title: Journalists and White House, Leo 'I am pleased you are all here'
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV welcomes journalists favorably, emphasizing the importance of media coverage in all circumstances and locations.

stories.title: Esaltavano suprematisti e proponevano attentati, perquisiti quattordici minori

en.title: Fourteen minors searched for glorifying supremacists and proposing attacks
en.summary: Italian authorities conducted searches nationwide against minors who were members of extremist groups including Nuovo Ordine Europeo and Fronte Fascista Italiano and allegedly advocated violent acts.

stories.title: Accesso negato a testate da Trump, Papa Leone ai giornalisti: "Sono felice che siate tutti qui"

en.title: Access denied to outlets by Trump, Pope Leo to journalists: "I am happy that you are all here"
en.summary: The Pope emphasized to journalists the importance of comprehensive media coverage while responding to recent restrictions on press access implemented by Trump.

stories.title: Esaltavano suprematisti e proponevano attentati, 14 minori perquisiti. Trovati anche dei coltelli

en.title: Fourteen minors searched for glorifying supremacists and proposing attacks; knives also found
en.summary: Authorities investigated minors who simulated killings of members of ethnic minorities in online games and were associated with extremist groups.

stories.title: Volkswagen e Audi richiamano quasi 3 milioni di veicoli: problemi allo sterzo. I modelli coinvolti

en.title: Volkswagen and Audi recall nearly 3 million vehicles: steering problems. Models involved
en.summary: Volkswagen and Audi initiated a recall of approximately three million vehicles due to a corroded screw defect in the steering system, with replacement provided at no cost.

stories.title: Morta a Roma la sceneggiatrice e produttrice Silvia d'Amico, figlia di Suso Cecchi

en.title: Screenwriter and producer Silvia d'Amico, daughter of Suso Cecchi, dies in Rome
en.summary: Silvia d'Amico, an 85-year-old screenwriter and producer and daughter of filmmaker Suso Cecchi, has died in Rome. She worked on the production of Rossellini's film The Messiah.

stories.title: Papa Leone ai giornalisti dopo il blocco di Trump alla Casa Bianca: “Qui siete tutti benvenuti”

en.title: Pope Leo welcomes journalists after Trump's White House press restrictions: "Everyone is welcome here"
en.summary: During a flight from Rome to Paris, Pope Leo addressed accompanying journalists, emphasizing the importance of press coverage for all. He also commented on the humanitarian crisis in Ceuta.

stories.title: Il Papa in Francia, Éric-Emmanuel Schmitt: “Tutti curiosi di Leone, l’assenza di Francesco spiazzò”

en.title: The Pope in France, Éric-Emmanuel Schmitt: "Everyone curious about Leo, Francis's absence surprised us"
en.summary: French playwright Éric-Emmanuel Schmitt discussed Pope Leo's visit to France beginning today, noting public interest in the new pontiff. Schmitt described the Pope's artificial intelligence encyclical as representing human resistance evident in historical examples.

stories.title: Torino, ucciso a coltellate e bastonate: il corpo fatto a pezzi e nascosto nei sacchi

en.title: Turin, man killed by stab and bludgeon wounds: body dismembered and hidden in bags
en.summary: Police discovered a dismembered body in an apartment in the Vittoria district of Turin. Two men in their twenties are being questioned at police headquarters.

stories.title: Grimaldi: «2025 positivo, al via due progetti per le navi del futuro»

en.title: Grimaldi: "2025 positive, two projects for ships of the future underway"
en.summary: Grimaldi reports that 2025 has been a positive year with solid results, though not reaching exceptional record levels from previous years, despite challenging market conditions.

stories.title: In Calabria, Sardegna e Sicilia i primi treni a idrogeno a scartamento ridotto al mondo

en.title: In Calabria, Sardinia and Sicily the world's first narrow-gauge hydrogen trains
en.summary: Swiss company Stadler has manufactured 21 hydrogen-powered trains for three Italian regional operators: 10 for Sardinian regional transport, 9 for Calabrian railways, and 2 for Sicilian Circumetnea railway.

stories.title: Sui costruttori la scure degli extra-costi

en.title: Construction companies face the burden of extra costs
en.summary: Construction industry representatives report that material costs including concrete, plastic, bitumen, and electrical cables continue rising, eroding profits and reducing available liquidity.

stories.title: All’Ospedale di Niguarda una “Casa” per le famiglie dei bimbi in pediatria

en.title: A "House" for families of children in pediatrics at Niguarda Hospital
en.summary: A new 600-square-meter facility was inaugurated in the pediatrics department at Niguarda Hospital in Milan, expanding Casa Ronald McDonald Italia Ets' presence within the hospital.

stories.title: Hitachi Rail lancia il primo intercity elettrico a batteria. Trenitalia ne ha ordinati sei

en.title: Hitachi Rail launches first battery-electric intercity train. Trenitalia has ordered six
en.summary: Hitachi Rail introduced its first battery-electric intercity train, manufactured in Pistoia and Naples facilities. The train operates on both electrified lines and in battery mode with 100 kilometers of range on non-electrified routes, with Trenitalia placing an order for six units.
